name: motion-mask-wipe
title: Mask Wipe
description: Nội dung đứng yên, một mép che quét từ trái sang phải để lộ ra, có vạch màu chạy theo mép.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s (0.7, power4.inOut): the edge travels 0 → 115 % of the width
options.edge: px of the line (8; 0 to hide)
options.exitAt: s after the start to fade (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Content stays still; a left-to-right clip opens it: the cover edge travels 0 → 115 % of the box width in 700 ms power4.inOut (easeInOutQuint), so the content is fully shown at ~87 % of the move. A 2 px accent line with a small ▼ marker rides the edge while it is inside the box. Exit: fade 320 ms power2.in. Params: duration (0.7 s) · direction: hướng quét (trái → phải) · edge: vạch mép (2 px, bật/tắt) · ease (power4.inOut).
moworks.titleVi: Mặt nạ quét lộ nội dung
